name: Hero Pink
summary: Webflow component Hero Pink (Top sections): a Vivid Pink section with Darker Pink Splash hooks, a white headline, white body text and a white Get started button beside a white image card (image on the right). Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Webflow component Hero Pink (Top sections): a Vivid Pink section with Darker Pink Splash hooks, a white headline, white body text and a white Get started button beside a white image card (image on the right).
Vivid Pink surface follows the colour rules for a Vivid Pink surface: white heading and body, white button with Vivid Pink text, Darker Pink Splash hooks, white image card
Splash hooks follow the Splash geometry in the colour rules: the right layout (meeting point 75% across, 55% down) beside the image
Container width 1280px, 64px padding and gap, copy at most 720px and image card at most 680px (960px when stacked) as in Webflow; stacks below 991px and tightens at 479px
Headline, body, button label and link, and the image are per-page content; the image slot is a placeholder box in the preview
Rule 3.5 (the first screen is white) clashes with a coloured hero; logged in the Webflow scan, the colour rules are unchanged
